messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
Handed to the team · RMA approval pending since Nov 6 with no reply to customer; drop-shipped unit ne

Chris, I'm sorry. You were told on November 6 that an email about your BS-2 return would come shortly, and five days later it still hasn't.

The order itself arrived. Your BS-2 shipped September 7 and was delivered to (address hidden) on September 18. The return for the faulty unit hasn't been approved yet, so there's no return label.

I've sent the team your case again with Hal's diagnosis and your test results, and asked them to approve the return and send you the instructions. Someone will pick up your ticket and email you an answer. You can reply to that email with the video.

I understand, Chris. The BS-2 died, your first ticket sat for days, and then the email we said would come on November 6 never did. That's on us, not you.

Your case is now marked for the team with everything already in it: Hal's diagnosis of the short on the AIO 12V input, your test results, and the fact that the unit was never overclocked. You won't need to explain any of it again.

To say sorry for the runaround, I've made you a code: HD-••••••. It takes $25 off a future order over $100 and only you can use it.
When can I expect the RMA?

I can't give you a date for the approval, Chris, and I won't guess one. It hasn't been approved yet, and that decision belongs to the team.

Once it's approved, you'll get an email with the return instructions and the label. That email is also where you can send your video.

Your ticket is open and flagged as overdue, so it won't slip again. One thing will help the team move faster: if the return is approved, do you want the same BS-2 back as a replacement, or would you look at a different unit?
I am open to a different unit.

Good, that gives the team more options, Chris. The BS-2 is out of stock, so here's what we have right now.

The Hammer Thor P2 does 10 TH/s and costs $385, close to the $390 you paid. It's in stock and ships within 2 business days.

The Bitfortun BS-4 does 18 TH/s at $599.99. It's a pre-order that ships from the manufacturer by November 30, and as an upgrade it would cost the difference.

I've added your preference to the order for the team. Nothing is final until they approve the return. Which one would you lean toward?
The Thor or maybe the Harlo H15

I've noted both on your order for the team, Chris.

The Thor P2 is the like-for-like option. It's in stock and ships within 2 business days.

The Harlo H15 Dual is $799. It's a pre-order that ships by November 30. Since it costs more than the $390 you paid for the BS-2, it would be an upgrade and you'd pay the difference of about $409.

Neither is final until the team approves the return. When they email you, tell them which one you've picked and they'll set it up.

You're welcome, Chris. I'm sorry this has dragged on as long as it has.

Everything is on your order: Hal's diagnosis, your test results, and your choice of the Thor P2 or the H15. You won't have to go through any of it again. The team's email will have the return approval and the next steps, and you can send your video in your reply to it.

Until then, keep the BS-2 unplugged.
Take care, Chris. Your return is flagged with the team, and their email will come to this address.
